target.title: fix(ui): chat workspace panel leaves an empty gap when collapsed
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where collapsing the session workspace panel in the Control UI chat view still reserved a 52px empty rail on the right edge. The chat content stopped short of the window, leaving a permanent dead gap with two orphaned icons floating in it — the panel looked half-closed instead of closed.

## Why This Change Was Made

When the workspace rail is collapsed, the workbench grid now drops the rail column entirely (`minmax(0, 1fr)` single column) and the expand toggle floats over the chat's top-right corner as a small glass button, matching the existing circular nav-toggle pattern. The decorative file icon in the collapsed strip was removed along with its now-dead CSS; the expanded rail is unchanged. The toggle keeps its accessible name (`Expand session workspace`) and `aria-expanded` state.

## User Impact

Closing the workspace panel now gives the full width back to the chat. The expand control stays visible and clickable in the top-right corner, so the panel remains one click away.

## Evidence

**Before** — collapsed panel still reserves an empty rail (note the gap on the right edge):

![before: collapsed rail reserves an empty 52px column](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/workspace-rail-collapse/before-collapsed.png)

**After** — collapsed panel frees the full width; the expand toggle floats in the corner:

![after: collapsed rail takes no width, floating expand toggle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/workspace-rail-collapse/after-collapsed.png)

**After (expanded)** — the open panel is unchanged:

![after: expanded workspace rail unchanged](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/workspace-rail-collapse/after-expanded.png)

Validation:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/ui/views/chat.test.ts` — 137 passed, including the updated collapsed-rail test asserting the workbench drops the rail column and the floating toggle stays reachable.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/ui/e2e/chat-flow.e2e.test.ts` — 19 passed (Playwright), covering collapse → expand → collapse round-trips and the ≤1120px viewport where the rail hides entirely.
- Screenshots captured with the repo's Playwright e2e harness (mock gateway, light theme, 1360×860@2x) on this branch; "before" captured from the parent commit with the same harness.
- `oxfmt --check` and `scripts/run-oxlint.mjs` clean on touched files.
